entries.test: Public results from LLMs improved solely through additional data and parameters could demonstrate whether pure scaling reaches a performance limit and whether it eliminates hallucinations and basic errors.
entries.note: The central prediction has no deadline. The statement about scaling laws is a separate, present-tense characterization.
The record faithfully combines an asserted failure with an inferred private motive for shipping. Public performance evidence could assess failure, but cannot settle the attributed desire and motive.

entries.test: Public GPT-5 technical documentation and release materials would establish whether OpenAI incorporated test-time compute and other approaches beyond pure scaling.
entries.note: GPT-5 has been released by the evaluation date, making the firm core assessable. The synthetic-data suspicion and tentative domain comparison are not firm predictions.

entries.test: Public evidence of continued AI development and deployment after pure scaling ceases to deliver advances would establish that AI continues despite that limitation.
entries.note: The plain reading is continued AI activity despite limits to pure scaling. No deadline is specified.
